{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA test orders: revenue >= 100000
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] >= 100000
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]

# Remove QA test orders and refunded orders
# Keep only completed orders with revenue < 100000
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] < 100000)]

# Check the final dataset
print(f"Final dataset size: {len(filtered_df)}")
print(f"Unique channels: {filtered_df['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique customer_segment: {filtered_df['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Now compute conversion rates by channel
conversion_rates = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
diff_rate = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Check for confounding by customer_segment
# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(filtered_df['channel'], filtered_df['customer_segment']))

# Print final results
print(f"Conversion rate - email: {email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate - paid_search: {paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {diff_rate:.4f}")"}
